fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.value: Il s'agit d'un commentaire et d'une exploration via un webinaire.
fields.quote: In this commentary, we discuss ChatGPT and our perspectives on its utility to systematic reviews through the appropriateness and applicability of its responses to systematic review tasks and prompts.

fields.label: Modèles
fields.quote: On March 15, 2023, GPT-4.0 was released for testing among OpenAI’s paid subscribers [18].

fields.label: Limites
fields.value: Les auteurs signalent que ChatGPT ne fournit pas de références vérifiables et nécessite une expertise méthodologique pour corriger ses erreurs.
fields.quote: A particularly strong limitation of the system is the lack of referencing appropriate and verifiable sources when asked for factual information.
